groups.place: THE NEW WAR, THEN JADE SHADOWS

rows.label: The New War, then Jade Shadows

groups.meta: ~6-8 min per run; summon the Sister every run

rows.label: Vestigial Motes
rows.note: ~18 per run with the Sister on normal, ~26 on Steel Path
rows.alt: or a 4.63% blueprint drop per run, as a bonus

conditions: Pick up 3 Sister Beacons during the elevator ride so a Sister of Parvos spawns at the top; killing her is worth doing every run.
Boosted Ionic Charges (bright pickups within ~50m of the elevator) give 3x speed for 10s, stacking to 50s; keep the boost running instead of fighting enemies during the ride.
Boosters, loot abilities and Resourceful Retriever do not raise mote drops.
bonuses: Run it on Steel Path if unlocked; it adds motes without making the mission longer, and the Sister there gives a guaranteed arcane plus Steel Essence.
Mobile frames (Zephyr, Titania, Wukong) speed up charge and beacon collection; stealth frames work too since the capsule is invulnerable during the ride.
Silence (Banshee, or Helminth Silence) stops the Jade Light Eximus beams from casting.

disclosures.title: the elevator phase is not a defense
disclosures.body: Killing enemies during the ride does nothing for the objective. Throw boosted charges immediately and save normal charges for when the power meter runs low; once the elevator is about 20m from the top it finishes on its own.

conditions: Motes are per-player and don't expire, and are shared across the whole Jade package (frame parts, Cantare and Harmony also cost 300 each).

rows.label: Evensong
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 700 Salvage, 1,100 Plastids, 20 Gallium, 10 Control Module

conditions: MR 10 to equip and level it, though the blueprint can be bought and built earlier.
